feature: Replace Mock JWT with Proper Cryptographic JWT Tokens
workflow_rationale: This is a refactor workflow because we're replacing an existing insecure authentication system (mock JWT) with a proper cryptographic implementation. The old system must continue working during the transition, and we follow the pattern: Add New → Migrate → Remove Old → Verify.

phases.name: Add New JWT System
phases.description: Install JWT library and create new JWT service and middleware alongside the existing mock implementation

subtasks.description: Install jsonwebtoken library and type definitions
subtasks.notes: Use jsonwebtoken library which is the industry standard for Node.js JWT handling

subtasks.description: Create JWT service for token generation and verification

verification.command: cd apps/api && npx tsx -e "import { JwtService } from './src/core/auth/jwt.service'; const service = new JwtService('test-secret'); const token = service.generateToken('user123', 'tenant456'); console.log(token.split('.').length === 3 ? 'OK' : 'FAIL');"

subtasks.notes: Service should have methods: generateToken(userId, tenantId, expiresIn?), verifyToken(token), decodeToken(token). Use HS256 algorithm for signing.

subtasks.description: Create JWT verification middleware for Fastify

verification.command: cd apps/api && npx tsx -e "import { createJwtMiddleware } from './src/core/auth/jwt.middleware'; const middleware = createJwtMiddleware('test-secret'); console.log(typeof middleware === 'function' ? 'OK' : 'FAIL');"

subtasks.notes: Middleware should extract Bearer token from Authorization header, verify it, and set request.userId and request.tenantId. Should return RFC 7807 error for invalid tokens.

subtasks.description: Register JWT service in dependency container

verification.command: cd apps/api && grep -q "JwtService" src/main.ts && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.notes: Register JwtService in container using JWT_SECRET from environment. Follow the pattern used for AuditService registration.

phases.name: Migrate to New JWT System
phases.description: Update auth.controller.ts to use the new JWT service and add middleware to Fastify request pipeline

subtasks.description: Update auth.controller.ts to use JwtService instead of generateMockToken

verification.command: cd apps/api && grep -q "jwtService.generateToken" src/modules/auth/auth.controller.ts && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.notes: Replace generateMockToken() calls with jwtService.generateToken() in login, refresh, and callback endpoints. Keep generateMockToken function for now (will remove in phase 3).

subtasks.description: Add JWT verification middleware to Fastify request pipeline

verification.command: cd apps/api && grep -q "jwtMiddleware" src/adapters/fastify.adapter.ts && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.notes: Add JWT middleware BEFORE the existing header extraction hook. Middleware should run on all routes except /api/auth/login, /api/auth/callback, and /api/public/*. Use onRequest hook with route filtering.

phases.name: Remove Mock JWT Implementation
phases.description: Remove the old generateMockToken function and header-based auth

verification.command: cd apps/api && ! grep -q "generateMockToken" src/modules/auth/auth.controller.ts && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.notes: Delete the generateMockToken function and its comment about being a mock implementation.

verification.command: cd apps/api && ! grep -q "x-user-id" src/adapters/fastify.adapter.ts && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.notes: Remove the lines that set request.userId and request.tenantId from headers. JWT middleware now handles this.

phases.name: Integration Verification
phases.description: Verify all authentication flows work with proper JWT tokens and all tests pass

subtasks.description: Update auth controller tests to work with real JWT tokens
subtasks.notes: Update test-utils.ts to generate real JWT tokens for tests. Update auth.controller.test.ts to verify tokens are properly formatted JWTs (3 parts separated by dots).

subtasks.description: End-to-end verification of JWT authentication flow

steps: Verify response contains JWT token (3 parts)
Use token in Authorization: Bearer <token> header

subtasks.notes: This verifies the complete flow: login → receive JWT → use JWT → verify protected routes require JWT

subtasks.description: Verify JWT tokens cannot be forged

verification.instructions:
1. Generate a valid token via /api/auth/login
2. Decode the token and modify the payload (change userId)
3. Re-encode with Base64
4. Attempt to use modified token
5. Verify request is rejected with 401 Unauthorized
6. Verify error message indicates invalid signature

subtasks.notes: This proves tokens are cryptographically signed and cannot be tampered with

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution required due to dependencies

acceptance_criteria: All auth endpoints return properly signed JWT tokens (3-part format)
JWT tokens include HS256 signature using JWT_SECRET
JWT tokens cannot be forged or modified without detection
All protected routes reject requests without valid JWT
All protected routes reject requests with invalid/expired JWT
All existing auth tests pass with real JWT tokens
No mock token generation code remains in codebase

verification_steps.name: Security Scan - JWT Implementation
verification_steps.command: cd apps/api && grep -r 'generateMockToken' src/ || echo 'OK: No mock tokens found'

verification_steps.name: Security Scan - Proper JWT Usage
verification_steps.command: cd apps/api && grep -r 'jsonwebtoken' src/core/auth/ && echo 'OK: JWT library in use' || echo 'FAIL'

verification_strategy.reasoning: Critical risk change - authentication is a foundational security control. Requires comprehensive testing including security verification to ensure tokens cannot be forged.

checks: Tokens include iss and aud claims
No plaintext userId/tenantId in headers accepted
